Description of Final Product¶

This infographic visualizes how different audio features—such as danceability, energy, tempo, and loudness—relate to track popularity on Spotify showing how musical qualities contribute to listener appeal. To do this, we explored multiple variables in order to transform the dataset into a visual-friendly yet informative infographic thta highlights the most recognized attributes that exist among highly-popular songs. Hence, our composition combines plots ranging from scatterplots, to bar charts, and a heatmap in the hopes of presenting a clear and data-driven narrative.
